new_task_1.title: Generate Meson dependency metadata for required packages in `meson_lib` templates
new_task_1.description: The `conan new` Meson library template now recognizes declared `requires` values, emits a `requirements()` method for them in the generated recipe, and generates `PkgConfigDeps` files before the Meson toolchain so Meson-based builds can resolve those Conan dependencies through pkg-config.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that generated `meson_lib` recipes can consume template-declared Conan requirements without manual recipe edits, and that Meson projects receive the dependency metadata they need to discover those packages during configuration.

expectation.grounded: When the `meson_lib` template is rendered with `requires` defined, the generated recipe must import `PkgConfigDeps`, define a `requirements()` method that calls `self.requires(...)` for each declared requirement, and call `PkgConfigDeps(self).generate()` in `generate()` before `MesonToolchain(self).generate()`. When `requires` is not defined, those requirement-specific additions must not be emitted.
expectation.conceptual: Users generating a Meson library recipe with declared dependencies should get a working starting point that both records the Conan requirements and prepares Meson-facing dependency files automatically, instead of having to add those pieces by hand after scaffolding.

constraints.grounded: The change is limited to the generated `meson_lib` recipe template. It must preserve the existing Meson toolchain generation flow and only add the `PkgConfigDeps` import, `requirements()` method, and dependency generation block when requirements were supplied to the template.
constraints.conceptual: The template should stay backward compatible for dependency-free Meson projects while improving the out-of-the-box experience for Meson templates that declare Conan dependencies.

behavior: A generated `meson_lib` recipe includes a `requirements()` method when template `requires` are provided.
That generated `requirements()` method registers each declared dependency with `self.requires(...)`.
The generated recipe imports and runs `PkgConfigDeps` before generating the Meson toolchain when requirements are present.
Dependency-free `meson_lib` templates continue to omit the extra requirements and `PkgConfigDeps` scaffolding.
acceptance_criteria: When a user generates a `meson_lib` recipe with one or more declared requirements, the resulting recipe should contain `from conan.tools.gnu import PkgConfigDeps`.

When a user generates a `meson_lib` recipe with one or more declared requirements, the resulting recipe should define `requirements()` entries that call `self.requires(...)` for each supplied requirement.
When such a generated recipe runs `generate()`, it should call `PkgConfigDeps(self).generate()` before `MesonToolchain(self).generate()`.
When a user generates a `meson_lib` recipe without declared requirements, the template should not add the `PkgConfigDeps` import or `requirements()` method solely because of this change.
